_metadata.description: Portal v0 foundation requirements linked to PRD operational targets.

requirements.title: Healthy Portal scaffold
requirements.description: Portal starts through the Vrooli scenario lifecycle, exposes API/UI/CLI health, and degrades cleanly when optional integrations are unavailable.

validation.notes: Lifecycle checks pass: `vrooli scenario status portal` and `vrooli scenario status search-hub` report healthy after the degradation drill; focused Portal API and CLI tests pass.

requirements.title: Chat-ready contract foundation
requirements.description: Portal owns typed Connect/proto seams for health, chat, message tree, integration status, and search suggestion behavior.

validation.notes: Generated Portal Connect contracts, Portal API Go tests, and Portal UI type-check and coverage checks pass after proto generation.

requirements.title: OpenRouter chat path
requirements.description: Portal streams OpenRouter completions with model selection, optional web search, usage capture, and missing-key status instead of boot failure.

validation.notes: The OpenRouter completion path is implemented and covered by Portal completion tests. A live streamed-completion smoke requires an operator-provided OpenRouter credential and is not claimed here.

requirements.title: Agent-mode bridge
requirements.description: Portal can start and display agent-manager backed conversations without making agent-manager a required boot dependency.

validation.notes: Agent-mode brief assembly and degradation behavior are implemented and covered by Portal agent-chat tests. An authenticated live agent-manager stream is not claimed because the current environment rejects owned-context requests without an account.

requirements.title: Passive ecosystem search
requirements.description: Portal requests search-hub suggestions and PASSIVE search attachments without blocking the LLM send path.

validation.notes: The current-turn brief path is implemented and covered by Portal message/completion tests; the previous-turn attachment path is no longer used for brief assembly. A live authenticated chat smoke remains unclaimed.

requirements.title: Readiness ladder controls
requirements.description: Portal measures optional integration readiness, applies OFF/PASSIVE/FULL-reserved policy, and surfaces override/status controls.

validation.notes: The lifecycle degradation drill observed Search Hub OFF, persisted withheld brief verdicts, silent hook no-op behavior, recovery to PASSIVE, and a delivered recovery brief.

requirements.title: One Portal-owned context brief path
requirements.description: Portal builds one threshold-gated, trust-labelled brief from the current prompt and serves the persisted verdict to LLM, agent, and canary-verified external-harness consumers without a legacy recent-context injection path.

validation.notes: agentbrief-go unit tests and Portal API tests cover normalization, trust policy, all gate verdicts, withheld persistence, current-turn LLM assembly, and agent prompt assembly. Live hook canary and end-to-end inspector evidence remain release gates.
